local Players = game:GetService("Players") local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService") local RunService = game:GetService("RunService") local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
if _G.__CRATE_STATE and _G.__CRATE_STATE.running then _G.__CRATE_STATE.halt() print("[ALT] halted — execute again to boot") return end
local CONFIG = { webhook = "https://discord.com/api/webhooks/1574182521871147028/MOGhJuGoyoEs5iUv0FQDszRubI0YGEcrzjt21-1bWzvCLmMejqUKVBN7CMX9Fy__eddN", concurrency = 999, -- total workers, not per-crate minDelay = 0.2, -- seconds maxDelay = 0.2, -- seconds; randomized per fire currencies = { "Coins", "Gems" }, stopKey = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift, chatCommands = { ";stop", "/stop", ";halt", "/halt", ";off" }, statsEverySec = 10, debugAttempts = 8, watchdogPeriod = 3, stallThreshold = 30, }
local crateNames = { "KnifeBox1", "KnifeBox2", "KnifeBox3", "KnifeBox4", "KnifeBox5", "GunBox1", "GunBox2", "GunBox3", "MysteryBox1", "MysteryBox2", "MLG Box", "ThanksGiving_Box", }
local godlies = { ["FireBat"]=true, ["FireDog"]=true, ["Deathshard"]=true, ["Fang"]=true, ["Saw"]=true, ["Slasher"]=true, ["Tides"]=true, ["Gemstone"]=true, ["Darkbringer"]=true, ["Lightbringer"]=true, ["Heat"]=true, ["Luger"]=true, ["Shark"]=true, ["Laser"]=true, ["Doombringer"]=true, }
local chromas = { ["Chroma Seer"]=true, ["Chroma Gingerblade"]=true, ["Chroma Slasher"]=true, ["Chroma Fang"]=true, ["Chroma Deathshard"]=true, ["Chroma Tides"]=true, ["Chroma Gemstone"]=true, ["Chroma Heat"]=true, ["Chroma Luger"]=true, ["Chroma Shark"]=true, ["Chroma Laser"]=true, ["Chroma Lightbringer"]=true, ["Chroma Darkbringer"]=true, ["Chroma Saw"]=true, ["Chroma Star"]=true, ["Chroma Corrupt"]=true, ["Chroma Boneblade"]=true, ["Chroma Snowflake"]=true, ["Chroma Elderwood Blade"]=true, }
local spawnFn = (task and task.spawn) or spawn local heartbeat = RunService.Heartbeat local hbWait = heartbeat.Wait local pcall = pcall local clock = os.clock local random = math.random
math.randomseed(tick() * 1000 % 1000000)
local requestFn, requestFnName do local tbl = (typeof and typeof(syn) == "table" and syn) or {} if type(tbl.request) == "function" then requestFn, requestFnName = tbl.request, "syn.request" end if not requestFn and typeof and typeof(http) == "table" and type(http.request) == "function" then requestFn, requestFnName = http.request, "http.request" end if not requestFn and type(http_request) == "function" then requestFn, requestFnName = http_request, "http_request" end if not requestFn and type(request) == "function" then requestFn, requestFnName = request, "request" end end
local remote do local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes") local shop = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Shop") remote = shop and shop:FindFirstChild("OpenCrate") end if not remote then warn("[ALT] remote not found") return end
pcall(function() game:GetService("NetworkClient"):SetOutgoingKBPSLimit(math.huge) end)
local state = { running = true, stopped = false, totalFires = 0, totalSuccess = 0, godlyCount = 0, chromaCount = 0, webhookSent = 0, webhookFail = 0, lastFireAt = clock(), restarts = 0, perCurrency = {}, perCrate = {}, } for _, c in ipairs(CONFIG.currencies) do state.perCurrency[c] = 0 end for _, c in ipairs(crateNames) do state.perCrate[c] = 0 end
local generation = 0
local function extractItemName(r) if type(r) == "string" then return r end if type(r) == "table" then return r.Name or r.name or r.Item or r.item or r.Value or r.value or r[1] end end
local function postWebhook(text) if not requestFn then return false end local ok, err = pcall(function() requestFn({ Url = CONFIG.webhook, Method = "POST", Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" }, Body = HttpService:JSONEncode({ content = text }), }) end) if ok then state.webhookSent = state.webhookSent + 1 else state.webhookFail = state.webhookFail + 1; warn("[ALT] webhook: " .. tostring(err)) end return ok end
local function notifyGodly(item, crate, currency) print(string.format("GODLY FOUND: %s [%s/%s]", item, crate, currency)) state.godlyCount = state.godlyCount + 1 postWebhook(string.format("HIT (%s): %s [%s/%s]", LocalPlayer.Name, tostring(item), crate, currency)) end
local function notifyChroma(item, crate, currency) print(string.format("CHROMA FOUND: %s [%s/%s]", item, crate, currency)) state.chromaCount = state.chromaCount + 1 postWebhook(string.format("CHROMA (%s): %s [%s/%s]", LocalPlayer.Name, tostring(item), crate, currency)) end
local function classify(item) if not item then return nil end if chromas[item] then return "chroma" end if godlies[item] then return "godly" end end
local lastStats = clock() local function tick() local now = clock() if (now - lastStats) >= CONFIG.statsEverySec then local cur = {} for _, c in ipairs(CONFIG.currencies) do cur[#cur+1] = c .. "=" .. tostring(state.perCurrency[c] or 0) end print(string.format("[ALT] %d req/s | godly %d | chroma %d | wh %d/%d | %s", state.totalFires / (now - lastStats), state.godlyCount, state.chromaCount, state.webhookSent, state.webhookFail, table.concat(cur, " "))) state.totalFires = 0 for _, c in ipairs(CONFIG.currencies) do state.perCurrency[c] = 0 end for _, c in ipairs(crateNames) do state.perCrate[c] = 0 end lastStats = now end end
local halt halt = function(reason) if state.stopped then return end state.stopped = true; state.running = false generation = generation + 1 _G.__CRATE_STATE = nil; _G.CRATE_STOP = nil print("[ALT] halted — " .. tostring(reason or "manual")) end state.halt = halt
-- ─── worker: random crate, random currency, random delay ────────────── local function worker(gen, workerId) local call = remote.InvokeServer local names = crateNames local nNames = #names local curs = CONFIG.currencies local nCurs = #curs local minD = CONFIG.minDelay local maxD = CONFIG.maxDelay
while state.running and gen == generation do local crate = names[random(nNames)] local currency = curs[random(nCurs)]
local ok, result = pcall(call, remote, crate, false, currency) if gen ~= generation then return end
state.totalFires = state.totalFires + 1 state.lastFireAt = clock() state.perCurrency[currency] = (state.perCurrency[currency] or 0) + 1 state.perCrate[crate] = (state.perCrate[crate] or 0) + 1
if CONFIG.debugAttempts > 0 and state.totalFires <= CONFIG.debugAttempts then print(string.format("[debug] w%d %s/%s ok=%s res=%s", workerId, crate, currency, tostring(ok), tostring(result))) end
if ok then state.totalSuccess = state.totalSuccess + 1 local item = extractItemName(result) local kind = classify(item) if kind == "chroma" then notifyChroma(item, crate, currency) elseif kind == "godly" then notifyGodly(item, crate, currency) end end
local d = minD + random() * (maxD - minD) if d > 0 then task.wait(d) end end end
-- ─── event path: same randomness, batched per frame ─────────────────── local function runEventPath(gen) local fire = remote.FireServer local names = crateNames local nNames = #names local curs = CONFIG.currencies local nCurs = #curs local burst = CONFIG.concurrency local conn conn = heartbeat:Connect(function() if not state.running or gen ~= generation then conn:Disconnect(); return end for _ = 1, burst do local crate = names[random(nNames)] local currency = curs[random(nCurs)] pcall(fire, remote, crate, false, currency) state.totalFires = state.totalFires + 1 state.perCurrency[currency] = (state.perCurrency[currency] or 0) + 1 state.perCrate[crate] = (state.perCrate[crate] or 0) + 1 end state.lastFireAt = clock() state.totalSuccess = state.totalSuccess + burst tick() end) end
local startAll startAll = function() generation = generation + 1 local gen = generation local ok, err = pcall(function() if remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then runEventPath(gen) print(string.format("[ALT] firing EVENT — %d fires/frame, random crate+currency", CONFIG.concurrency)) else for i = 1, CONFIG.concurrency do spawnFn(function() worker(gen, i) end) end spawnFn(function() while state.running and gen == generation do hbWait(heartbeat); tick() end end) print(string.format("[ALT] firing FUNCTION — %d workers, random crate+currency, delay %.0f-%.0fms", CONFIG.concurrency, CONFIG.minDelay * 1000, CONFIG.maxDelay * 1000)) end end) if not ok then warn("[ALT] startAll error: " .. tostring(err)) end end
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char) print("[ALT] CharacterAdded — restarting") generation = generation + 1 hbWait(heartbeat); hbWait(heartbeat); hbWait(heartbeat) if state.running and not state.stopped then startAll() end end)
LocalPlayer.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function() print("[ALT] CharacterRemoving") end)
LocalPlayer.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent) if not parent then print("[ALT] LocalPlayer removed from game") state.running = false end end)
spawnFn(function() local lastCheck = clock() while state.running and not state.stopped do hbWait(heartbeat) local now = clock() if (now - lastCheck) >= CONFIG.watchdogPeriod then local sinceFire = now - state.lastFireAt if sinceFire >= CONFIG.stallThreshold then state.restarts = state.restarts + 1 print(string.format("[ALT] WATCHDOG: no fire in %.1fs — restarting (#%d)", sinceFire, state.restarts)) startAll() end lastCheck = now end end end)
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe) if gpe then return end if input.KeyCode == CONFIG.stopKey then halt("hotkey") end end)
LocalPlayer.Chatted:Connect(function(msg) local low = msg:lower() for _, c in ipairs(CONFIG.chatCommands) do if low == c then halt("chat"); return end end end)
_G.CRATE_STOP = halt
print("[ALT] requestFn = " .. tostring(requestFnName or "NONE")) print("[ALT] remote class = " .. remote.ClassName) print("[ALT] currencies = " .. table.concat(CONFIG.currencies, ", ") .. " | concurrency = " .. CONFIG.concurrency)
startAll()
_G.__CRATE_STATE = state print("[ALT] stop: RightShift / chat ';stop' / _G.CRATE_STOP()")
